articles.title: India Emphasizes That Shipping Chaos, Not Supply, Is Driving High Oil Prices
articles.description: Oil prices are high not because the world is short on oil but because the trade routes have been severely disrupted, driving up freight and other costs, India’s Oil Minister Hardeep Singh Puri said.
